jurisdiction.name: Cayman Islands
jurisdiction.constitutionalFoundation: The Cayman Islands Constitution, 2009 (made under the Cayman Islands (Constitution) Order 2009, UK SI 2009/1379). British Overseas Territory; legal system descends from English common law; final appellate court is the Judicial Committee of the Privy Council (UK).

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the registration of strata titles and the management of subdivided properties.
primaryActs.summary: Cayman's strata-ownership regime. The 2013 Revision is the correct revision (cited as 2014 in some secondary sources — that is incorrect; corrected per [`project/strategy/fact-check-register.md`](project/strategy/fact-check-register.md:1)). Defines the strata lot, common property, the strata corporation, unit entitlement, and the Schedule 1 structural-change threshold (100% unanimous).
primaryActs._note: Revision year confirmed as 2013 per fact-check-register; '2014 Revision' in some reports is incorrect.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the ownership of freehold and leasehold interests in condominium units.
primaryActs.summary: Companion to the Strata Titles Registration Act. Governs the disposition of leasehold and freehold interests in condominium units, the registration of condominium plans, and the role of the developer. Cited in [`project/strategy/add-a-jurisdiction-cost-curve.md`](project/strategy/add-a-jurisdiction-cost-curve.md:1) as Cayman-specific strata unique.
primaryActs._note: Existence confirmed in the broader Cayman property-law literature; precise chapter number and citation pending Tier-1 confirmation.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the registration of land and the dealings with land in the Islands.
primaryActs.summary: Cayman's Torrens-style land-registration regime. The 2018 Revision is the current consolidation. Governs the Land Registry, certificates of title, caveats, and the effect of registration on priority and indefeasibility.
primaryActs._note: Revision year on the legislation.gov.ky Cayman portal is the 2018 Revision; older revisions (1995, 2004) are superseded.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the conferral of Caymanian status and permanent residence permits.
primaryActs.summary: Reciprocal status-permit regime. Governs how foreign residents become eligible for long-term residence and property ownership. Important for any leaseholder/resident tenure claim in the Cayman Islands. The Islands' immigration-system reform is a major legal-development area in 2025–2026.
primaryActs._note: Reference correct per the Cayman Islands Government portal; precise citation requires a Tier-1 confirmation pass.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the levying of stamp duty on instruments relating to property and other matters.
primaryActs.summary: Sets the stamp-duty rates on property transfers, mortgages, and lease assignments. The 2020 Revision is the current consolidation. Governs the Cayman Islands Government revenue from property transactions.

primaryActs.longTitle: An Act to provide for the acquisition of title to land by adverse possession.
primaryActs.summary: Defines the adverse-possession periods for unregistered land and the procedure for obtaining title. Companion to the Registered Land Act.
primaryActs._note: Reference correct per Cayman legal practice commentary; precise citation requires a Tier-1 confirmation pass.

regulations.summary: Forms and procedural regulations under the Strata Titles Registration Act — schedule of by-laws, certificate of incorporation, and rules of the strata corporation.
regulations._note: Title and year are representative; the exact S.I. number requires a Tier-1 confirmation pass.

statutoryInstruments.summary: Appointed the date on which the Strata Titles Registration Act came into operation in the Cayman Islands.
statutoryInstruments._note: Citation is representative; the precise S.I. number was not located in the public-facing gazette portal at the time of this scrape pass.

reformAmendments.summary: 2023 amendments to the Strata Titles Registration Act. The Cayman Islands Government has been actively seeking digital governance solutions for strata management; the 2023 amendments modernise the strata-corporation governance rules. Cited as the strategic Cayman opening in [`project/strategy/revenue-model-gtm.md`](project/strategy/revenue-model-gtm.md:84).
reformAmendments._note: Strategic-level signal confirmed; the precise amending instrument number is not yet pinned to a Tier-1 URL.

enforcementBodies.name: Cayman Islands Land Registry
powers: Register title under the Registered Land Act
Issue certified copies and official searches

enforcementBodies.name: Strata Titles Registration Tribunal
powers: Hear disputes under the Strata Titles Registration Act

enforcementBodies.name: Grand Court of the Cayman Islands
powers: Determine civil disputes including land, strata, and tenant matters
Grant injunctions (including against trespass and strata-corporate disputes)
Hear appeals from the Strata Titles Registration Tribunal

remedies.label: Strata Titles Registration Tribunal petition
remedies.description: Petition the Strata Titles Registration Tribunal for a determination under the Strata Titles Registration Act (e.g., Schedule 1 structural change; by-law enforcement).
remedies.applicableWhere: Owner of a strata lot in a registered strata plan; dispute over a Strata Titles Registration Act procedure.

remedies.label: Grand Court injunction / damages
remedies.description: Apply to the Grand Court for injunctive relief and/or damages where the Tribunal is unavailable or where the matter falls outside the Tribunal's jurisdiction.
remedies.applicableWhere: Strata-corporation defendant is deadlocked; broad civil-relief claim (e.g., misrepresentation, breach of fiduciary duty).

remedies.label: Lodge a caveat under the Registered Land Act
remedies.description: Lodge a caveat with the Cayman Islands Land Registry to protect a claimed interest in land; the Registrar will not register a dealing that would affect the caveated interest without notice.
remedies.applicableWhere: Person with a registrable interest in land; subject to a dealing that would defeat that interest.

remedies.label: Stamp Duty assessment appeal
remedies.description: Object to a Stamp Duty assessment within the prescribed period, then appeal to the Grand Court on a point of law.
remedies.applicableWhere: Person assessed to stamp duty; objection not resolved by the assessor.

remedies.label: Apply for title by adverse possession
remedies.description: Apply to the Grand Court for a declaration of title by adverse possession under the Land (Adverse Possession) Act.
remedies.applicableWhere: Person has been in continuous, exclusive possession of unregistered land for the statutory period.
